about_the_game:
"Between Adventures IDLE". Explore resource collection, crafting, quests, trading, and epic battles. Stay tuned and join the adventure! ⭐⚔️🛡️🔨🗺️

Between Adventures IDLE welcomes you into a vibrant, magical world filled with stories and quests waiting to unfold. Whether tackling the main storyline or exploring side adventures, there’s always something new to discover. Designed to be both strategic and relaxing, it offers an immersive experience that players can enjoy at their own pace.

What awaits you in our game? Here are the standout features of Between Adventures IDLE:

Skills

  • 🔨Deep Skill System:  +10 different skills (e.g., Mining, Gathering, Woodcutting, Fishing, Blacksmith, etc.).

  • 🛠️Crafting System: Craft your own items with a detailed crafting system.

  • ⬆️Upgrade & Enchanting Features: Strengthen your equipment and enhance them with special abilities.

Quest System

  • 📖Main Story Quests: Take your place in a legendary world with an immersive and emotional main story.

  • 📝Side Quests: Various side quests that enhance exploration and adventure.

  • ⏳Combat & Idle Quests: Dive into monster-filled battles while progressing through idle tasks at your own pace.

Adventure

  • ⚔️Exciting Battles: Engage in epic combat using melee, ranged, and magic skills against hundreds of monsters and challenging bosses.

  • 🧭Map: A vast world waiting to be explored and completed.

And more

  • ⭐5-Tier Item System: Obtain new gear with increasing power and unique attributes at every level.

  • 💰Various Vendors & Shops: Discover the golden rules of trade; unique merchants and shops offer exclusive items.

  • 🎯Skill Tree & Perk System: Customize your character with a skill tree and perk system tailored to your playstyle.

  • 🌐Surprise Online Features: Interact with friends and players worldwide in a dynamic online environment.

    and so much MORE…

Important

  • 🎨Clean & Simple Interface: A vibrant color palette, clean layout and clear, simple interface make your idle experience both enjoyable and smooth.

  • 🎮Easy Access, Deep Experience: An idle system that supports both active play and background progression.

  • 💸Premium Gaming Experience: No microtransactions, no pay-to-win mechanics, no in-game ads, no subscriptions, or no battle passes—just unlimited FUN!

Between Adventures IDLE offers a fresh take on adventure, combining strategy, exploration, trade, and combat in a way that's both engaging and approachable. Whether you prefer quick sessions or longer journeys, there's always something new to discover, making every moment enjoyable in its own way.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported

short_description: An Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources in a magical world, battle powerful creatures, and upgrade your gear. Explore new locations through main and side quests; your progress continues even in the background. A simple and enjoyable idle experience awaits you.
